title: List Page - Verify that user should not be able to delete Subscription Data Source column.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page

steps.action: Click on the check box for the column name (Subscription Column) and click on the delete button
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation pop up window should be open
Record should not be deleted and validation message should be populate for the same.
